_provenance: CALIBRATED 2026-11-11 from 11 successful Groq openai/gpt-oss-120b generation calls (request_traces + model_calls of the real balanced evaluation). Excludes application-side admission waiting, which is a separate measured quantity.

_measured.failures_observed: 0 of 14 real requests returned a 4xx/5xx or timed out

_divergence: The stand-in is an extractive baseline, not an LLM. Its latency distribution is fitted to the real calls, but it has no admission-wait model because that wait is produced by the application's own quota manager, which both paths share. The 2% random failure rate and the 18 s tail timeout were NOT observed in 14 real requests; they are kept as explicit assumptions so the failure paths are exercised, and are labelled low-confidence in the report.
note: calibrated to 11 real Groq calls on 2026-11-11; failure rates remain assumptions
